dialogues.speaker: Tirzad
dialogues.text: ...Oh, it's you. Is there anything else you want to discuss?

response.speaker: Tirzad
response.text: To think that I remained doubtful of him until the end. I'm such an awful person...

response.speaker: Tirzad
response.text: Now, all I have for him is gratitude...

response.speaker: Tirzad
response.text: I've never been able to commit before this, whether in academics or in life... But that ends now. I will take the path I believe in, no matter how difficult it may be...

response.speaker: Tirzad
response.text: This is the least I can do to pay my respects to him...

choices.text: I want to talk about King Deshret.

response.speaker: Tirzad
response.text: To be honest, I'm starting to doubt the credibility of the articles I've read...

response.speaker: Tirzad
response.text: That prayer... It gives me a strange feeling that I can't put a finger on. And Samail too... What he said... I think I should study it further once I get back.

response.speaker: Tirzad
response.text: Of course, my main mission is still to write my paper like I originally planned.

choices.text: Let's talk about Jeht for a moment.

response.speaker: Tirzad
response.text: *sigh* I, too, wish that I could do something for her, but...

response.speaker: Tirzad
response.text: And she refuses to say anything. If she would just speak her desire, I would be willing to do anything in my power to help her...!

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Sorry... I'm still not very good at controlling my emotions.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah... We know you're going through a tough time.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Thank you... May your travels be smooth.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon hopes that everything will go well for you too... Paimon's sure it will!

dialogues.speaker: Bonifaz
dialogues.text: Where are Omid and Mirsad? Are they...

dialogues.speaker: Nachtigal
dialogues.text: Don't worry. They're both fine. It's just that... they have other plans so they won't continue working with us.

dialogues.speaker: Bonifaz
dialogues.text: Huh? What do we do? We can't handle all the work with only the two of us. We've gotta hire more people! But who'd want to come to Aaru Village...

dialogues.speaker: Bonifaz
dialogues.text: Forget it, let's discuss this later. Anyway, Cyrus got back safely. That's at least something to be happy about, right? I'm never letting it go to such a dangerous place again.

dialogues.speaker: Nachtigal
dialogues.text: What are you talking about? We're Sumpter Beast merchants. What are we going to eat if our Sumpter Beasts don't work?

dialogues.speaker: Nachtigal
dialogues.text: You can't simply fill your belly with wind. Even if you could, open your mouth here, and I guarantee that you'll get a mouthful of sand instead...

dialogues.speaker: Bonifaz
dialogues.text: But we can't let Cyrus take risks. You look pretty strong to me, so why don't you carry our goods instead?
